notes: INSIDE half of the Basalt Pumice Flak: a feed rail where pumice rocks roll in one by one as it charges (frame 5 = five rocks loaded, strip yellow), power coupling, stone hatch. fire: the rail is empty and the strip flashes. damaged: the rail cracked, a rock jammed, slits dead; disabled: rocks spilled, rail snapped. Barrel layer basalt_pumice_flak_barrel: a porous grey pumice dome head with a short fat mortar mouth and a gunner slit (no sensor: a crew member aims it, in vacuum).
